newsitem.title: USA: Michaels Stores fiscal Dec sales higher.
newsitem.headline: Michaels Stores fiscal Dec sales higher.

text.p: Michaels Stores Inc said Thursday its sales for the fiscal month of December ending December 22 rose 8.0 percent to $203.2 million from $187.9 million for the same month last year.
The company said sales year-to-date in fiscal 1996 rose 5.0 percent to $1.24 billion from $1.18 billion last year. Year-to-date same-store sales fell 2.0 percent, it added.

The company also said it had sold options to purchase 2.0 million shares of its common stock at $10.50 per share on December 24. It sold the options through two private transactions with separate entities owned by independent trusts of which Wyly family members are beneficiaries.
Sam Wyly is Michaels' chairman and Charles Wyly is Michaels' vice chairman.
Michaels Stores Inc offers picture framing materials and services, silk and dried flowers, hobby and art supplies, creative crafts and party, seasonal and holiday merchandise.
